research_purpose: Before new native predictive learner, verify that public initial-state changes lead to distinguishable observed action transitions and that a strong conventional transition learner predicts heldout state change better than a fixed action-conditioned transition mean.

K4P_confounds: terminal-minus-reset feature shift virtually invariant within reaching arm across task goal offsets

source_design.new_physical_intervention: Use original public CausalWorld env.set_starting_state({'joint_positions': numpy float64 joints}, check_bounds=True) before env.reset in EVERY arm and public reset-only observer. Base joint positions are 3 repeats of (0,pi/4,-pi/4). Per joint j, initial displacement = 0.70*dx*(1 if j%3==0 else -.5) + 0.80*dy*(1 if j%3==1 else -.4) + 0.02*dx*((j//3)-1). All are safely inside original combined public intervention joint bounds. Require explicit success_signal True, otherwise fail closed without using the observations. No hidden state variables are supplied to policy; joint perturbation is a SOURCE/CONFOUND control, not model metadata.
source_design.goals: Source constructor from K4P, public reaches three goal points shifted by dx,dy; public pushing tool and goal blocks shift oppositely; public picking tool block shifts dx,dy.
source_design.action_menu: Unchanged K4H/K4P four distinct legal 9-joint-position action programs (all low, all mid, all high, mixed 20/80).
source_design.public_features: 128D tanh(raw structured obs/0.5), original K4P transformation; initial public obs x and final public obs z and state-change vector delta=z-x; never call private ground truth or use reward as a transition target.
source_design.train_data_boundary: FIT is simulator-physical-source calibration, not native candidate training. For a future ITD scientific trial all K4Q observed FIT/CHECK/DEV variants become consumed and excluded from future first-use.

qualify.FIT_first: Run FIT 12 genuinely distinct public start states per task family * 4 paired legal actions. Check all reset SHA identical within each source case and action distinct, nonfinite states/rewards absent, all actions have 1-8 physical steps, and action-conditioned final-minus-reset varies nontrivially in ≥2 trained/tested task families.
qualify.action_causality: At least 2 different actions per public source case produce final transition squared Euclidean distance >1e-4 for every family; per task family at least six of twelve FIT contexts yield distinct return profiles (max-min >0.01), and reaching FIT has at least two distinct realized reward-best action IDs.
qualify.observability: Each task family has 12 unique public initial observation hashes and for each legal arm at least 2 unique public final-state-delta hashes with maximum pairwise 128D squared-delta-distance >=1e-4. Fail fit eligibility otherwise.
qualify.early_stop: If any FIT source paired reset/action identity fails, or reaching lacks action-best diversity, or fewer than two of three task families have causal state transition variability, STOP WITHOUT CHECK/DEV consumption. Record original FIT negative.
qualify.forward_models: FIT-only per-family and per-arm fixed mean 128D public delta (constant control), fully trained 1-nearest-neighbor delta using 128D FIT reset public features (strong nonparametric conventional control), and FIT-only per-arm linear ridge lambda1 predicting 128D public delta from [1,128 initial public features] using sample-space ridge. No native predictive-state candidate is trained. All models see identical 12 FIT source outcomes per arm.
qualify.frozen_holdout: If FIT eligibility passes, save and JSON reload the FIT mean, 1NN records and ridge weights; freeze all fitted predictions on CHECK and DEV using SOURCE RESET-ONLY observations before generating ANY heldout rewards or transitions; verify all heldout source hashes before scoring.
qualify.positive: Among CHECK+DEV heldout conditions, original source state transitions must remain action-sensitive and the best trained conventional predictor among 1NN and ridge must improve 128D delta-MSE against the FIT mean-delta predictor by ≥5% in at least two of three task families, separately on CHECK and on DEV (DO NOT use the better model for future science without independent preregistration). At least two families must have >=2 hindsight best actions across entire heldout DEV. No native transfer, novel architecture, or efficiency claim from this qualifier alone.
qualify.negative: An action consequence that depends only on joint starting position and action while task goal changes but the resulting transition is independent of goal is a limited source. Report actual source differences, outcome diversity and baseline success separately, never label failed causal information evidence a new cognitive capability.
qualify.metrics: All FIT/CHECK/DEV original rows per action incl public reset/end hashes, raw public 128D transformed states, return, delta, model squared MSE; model train CPU and inference CPU per method, full run wall/CPU/peak RSS and ZIP member hashes. Repeat two independent Python OS processes on one runner and require identical science ignoring timing.
